definitions.explanation: The provision of funds by a financial institution to a business or individual.

examples.japanese: {銀行|ぎんこう}から{融資|ゆうし}を{受|う}ける。
{新規|しんき}{事業|じぎょう}のために{融資|ゆうし}を{申|もう}し{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I applied for a loan for a new business.

examples.japanese: {融資|ゆうし}{条件|じょうけん}を{確認|かくにん}する。

notes:
A formal term used in banking and business finance.

Common expressions:
- {融資|ゆうし}を{受|う}ける (to receive a loan)
- {融資|ゆうし}を{申|もう}し{込|こ}む (to apply for a loan)
- {融資|ゆうし}{審査|しんさ} (loan screening)
